title: Isi (sages whose father was named Isi)

paragraphs: Hyman cites R' Hanina bar Isi — Terumot, chapter 4, halakhah 4; Rabbah bar Isi — [Sotah 30a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sotah.30a.3).[^1]

notes.text: The linked Sotah gives Rav Asi or, in another version, Rabbah ben Isi reporting the ruling in Rav’s name. [Heilprin’s Rabbah entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=3153&lang=en) preserves the alternate transmission with bar. [His Chanina entry](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1486&lang=en) also cites Terumot 4:4, where the consulted text did not yield a matching notice. The two patronymics do not establish a shared father.
